tips.text: Run the Arcana bounty, not the plain Tier 3 vault; several threads agree it has better Sporothrix odds.
Take the Arcana bounty solo; stage requirements scale with squad size faster than extra players help, and a late joiner can cost you the bonus.
Run the plain vault in a pub if you like, then leave the party before the Arcana bounty; pubs often leave or kill the spawn pods the objective needs.
Take whatever the current rotation offers instead of waiting on the one part you are missing.
Turn in every matrix to Loid as you go and buy only the parts still missing at Necraloid Rank 3.
Bring Octavia: Mallet plus Amp pops the hidden tumors, and Mesa's Peacemaker can't hit them.
Bring Nekros Desecrate, a Resource Booster and Resourceful Retriever to raise the matrices the Necramechs drop.
On the emitter stage, leave your frame holding it, scout the crack in Operator, then transference back; the battery does not drain while it sits at the start.
Leave a fast-killing companion like Verglas at home on the fluid sac stage; it ruins the few-throws bonus.
Players called this one of the least favorite farms until Loid started selling the parts; with Entrati Rank 3 it is a predictable few days.
